electrical: What types of vehicles do you service?

We specialize in servicing all types of vehicles, including German cars such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, and Volkswagen. However, we also provide comprehensive services for all other makes and models.
Why is my check engine light on?
The check engine light can indicate a variety of issues, including problems with the electrical system. It’s essential to bring your vehicle in for a diagnostic scan to determine the exact cause.
How often should I have my vehicle's electrical system checked?
It’s a good idea to have your vehicle’s electrical system checked at least once a year or if you notice any signs of electrical issues. Regular maintenance can help prevent major problems.
Can a bad battery affect the electrical system?

Yes, a failing battery can cause various electrical issues, including trouble starting the car, dim lights, and malfunctioning electrical components. Regular battery testing can help ensure your battery is in good condition.
How do I know if my alternator is failing?

Signs of a failing alternator include dimming lights, battery warning light on the dashboard, slow or malfunctioning electrical accessories, and a dead battery. If you notice any of these symptoms, it’s crucial to have your alternator checked.
What should I do if my car won’t start?

If your car won’t start, it could be due to a variety of electrical issues, such as a dead battery, faulty starter, or ignition switch problems. Have your vehicle inspected by a professional to diagnose and fix the issue.
Why are my lights flickering or dim?
Flickering or dim lights can be caused by a weak battery, failing alternator, loose wiring, or faulty bulbs. An electrical diagnostic can help identify and resolve the problem.
Can you install aftermarket audio systems and accessories?

Yes, we can install a wide range of aftermarket audio systems, including stereos, speakers, subwoofers, and Bluetooth connectivity. We also install other electrical accessories like alarm systems and keyless entry.
How can I improve my car’s lighting?

You can upgrade to LED or HID headlights for better visibility, install additional lighting such as fog lights, or enhance your vehicle’s interior lighting with ambient lighting kits. Our technicians can recommend the best options for your vehicle.
What causes a car’s power windows to stop working?
Power windows can stop working due to a faulty window motor, bad switch, blown fuse, or wiring issues. We can diagnose and repair any issues with your power windows.
general: What are common signs of electrical problems in a car?

Common signs include dim or flickering lights, a dead battery, trouble starting the car, malfunctioning power accessories (like windows and locks), unusual smells (such as burning plastic), and warning lights on the dashboard.

transmission: What are the signs that my transmission needs overhauling?
Common signs include slipping gears, delayed or rough shifting, grinding noises, fluid leaks, and the transmission warning light on your dashboard.
How often should I service my transmission?
It’s generally recommended to service your transmission every 30,000 to 60,000 miles. However, check your vehicle’s owner manual for specific recommendations.
What is involved in a transmission overhaul?

A transmission overhaul involves disassembling the transmission, cleaning and inspecting all components, replacing worn or damaged parts, and reassembling the transmission with new seals, gaskets, and fluid.
How long does a transmission overhaul take?
The duration of a transmission overhaul can vary depending on the extent of the damage and the type of transmission. On average, it can take several days to complete.
Is it better to repair or replace my transmission?

Whether to repair or replace your transmission depends on the severity of the damage, the age of your vehicle, and the cost of the repair versus replacement. Our technicians can provide a detailed assessment and recommend the best course of action.
Can I drive my car if the transmission is acting up?
Driving with transmission issues can cause further damage and may lead to a breakdown. It’s best to have your vehicle inspected and repaired as soon as you notice any problems.
What does a transmission fluid change involve?
A transmission fluid change involves draining the old fluid, replacing the filter (if applicable), and refilling the transmission with new fluid to ensure smooth operation.
Will a transmission overhaul improve my vehicle's performance?
Yes, a transmission overhaul can significantly improve your vehicle’s performance by restoring proper function and efficiency to the transmission system.
